notes: Version 1.6 aligns the statements that consume Foundation with Foundation version 2.6. Irreducibility of the admissible fibre (Foundation Lemma 5.6) is conditional on A1 and A3, a representation-theoretic dictionary and an additional sector reading of A3, not derived, on which a decomposition stable under the admissible generators counts as premature selection; the non-commutation of a generating pair inherits these conditions. The discrete character of quantum transitions (Foundation Theorem 5.12) is postulated by A4, not derived: on the supplied Heisenberg shell realisation a realised Born-Infeld saturation depth is an integer (O22), and the existence of such a depth is not established; it moves from the proved results to the conditional results. No other statement is changed.
